section_summary: This section begins with procedural regulations governing committee meetings and joint sessions of the Japanese National Diet, followed by a comprehensive legislative summary prepared by SCAP Government Section documenting bills and budgets from the First National Diet. It also contains U.S. diplomatic airgrams reporting on internal party discipline enforced on Japan Communist Party Diet members and the political aspirations of former Vice Minister Katsuo Okazaki. Finally, correspondence between the Department of the Army and the Department of State documents the planning and approval of a 1950 U.S. study tour for fifteen Japanese Diet members to observe American legislative bodies.

subfiles.about: Procedural regulations governing the Legislative Committee, Joint Examination Meetings of Standing Committees, and Joint Committees of the Japanese Diet.
subfiles.summary: These Diet regulations define rules for the Legislative Committee, procedures for Joint Examination Meetings including public hearings and witness testimony, and operations of Joint Committees of both Houses.
subfiles.title: Regulations Governing Diet Committees and Joint Meetings

subfiles.about: Cover despatch transmitting five copies of the SCAP Government Section's legislative summary of the First National Diet.
subfiles.summary: Transmits five copies of the SCAP Government Section legislative summary covering the First National Diet.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 241: Legislative Summary of the First National Diet

subfiles.about: Comprehensive summary and status table of all bills and budgets introduced and passed during the First National Diet.
subfiles.from: Capt. R. G. Brown, Legislative Division, Government Section, GHQ SCAP
subfiles.summary: This report details all legislation introduced during the First National Diet from May 20 to December 9, 1947, organized by sponsoring ministry, cabinet board, or legislative chamber. It tracks passage dates through the House of Representatives and the House of Councillors for major economic, administrative, legal, and welfare reforms, including supplementary budgets. A concluding statistical table summarizes that 174 bills and 15 supplementary budgets passed while 12 bills failed.
subfiles.title: Legislative Summary - 1st National Diet (20 May 1947 - 9 December 1947)

subfiles.about: Report on the Japan Communist Party's establishment of strict party discipline and central committee control over its newly elected Diet members.
subfiles.summary: Reports that the Japan Communist Party instituted strict central control over its thirty-five Diet members under Sanzo Nozaka.
subfiles.title: Airgram A-36: Japan Communist Party Control Over Diet Members

subfiles.about: Report based on editor Kazuo Kawai that former Vice Minister Katsuo Okazaki plans to seek election to the National Diet.
subfiles.summary: Reports that former Vice Minister Katsuo Okazaki plans to run for the Diet to gain experience toward becoming Foreign Minister.
subfiles.title: Airgram A-144: Katsuo Okazaki's Political Plans

subfiles.about: State Department permanent record file copy sheet for airgram 894.03/2-1249 cross-referenced to decimal file 894.00B.
subfiles.summary: Permanent record file sheet for airgram 894.03/2-1249, cross-referenced to file 894.00B by Northeast Asian Affairs.
subfiles.title: File Sheet for Airgram 894.03/2-1249

subfiles.about: Request for State Department approval to bring approximately fifteen Japanese Diet members to the United States to study legislative systems.
subfiles.from: Col. G. P. Lynch, Chief, Reorientation Branch, Office of the Under Secretary, Department of the Army
subfiles.summary: Requests State Department approval for a forty-five-day U.S. study tour by fifteen Japanese Diet members in spring 1950.
subfiles.title: Letter Requesting State Department Approval for Japanese Diet Delegation Visit
subfiles.to: John M. Allison, Director, Office of Northeast Asian Affairs, Department of State

subfiles.about: Internal State Department routing note regarding the signing of correspondence concerning the Japanese Diet delegation visit.
subfiles.summary: Brief State Department routing note inquiring whether the response letter regarding the Diet visit has been signed.
subfiles.title: Routing Note Regarding Diet Visit Letter

subfiles.about: Letter granting State Department approval and support for the proposed visit of fifteen Japanese Diet members to the United States.
subfiles.from: John M. Allison, Director, Office of Northeast Asian Affairs, Department of State
subfiles.summary: Informs the Army that the Department of State fully supports the proposed U.S. visit of fifteen Japanese Diet members.
subfiles.title: Letter Approving U.S. Visit of Japanese Diet Members
subfiles.to: Col. G. P. Lynch, Chief, Reorientation Branch, Office of the Under Secretary, Department of the Army
